summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC furnished a Form 6-K announcing a new two-aircraft base at Rimini for Summer 2027, framed as a $200 million investment delivering 17 routes (five new), over 600,000 seats and roughly 500 local jobs, following Emilia-Romagna's abolition of the Municipal Tax. The release is operational and promotional, including a limited-time seat sale from 29.99 and a call for nationwide Italian tax reform. No securities, ownership stakes, board recommendations, advisors, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. No special-situation event is present; watch only for any future capital-commitment or fleet guidance changes.
